name: Circuit-breaker undervoltage ride-through interface
summary: Represents the defined delay or support circuit associated with an undervoltage release.
description: Represents the defined delay or support circuit associated with an undervoltage release. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Supply disturbance and support circuit” at the input and “Documented delayed release” at the output. Permitted delay must follow the selected release unit.
